data.name: Aisiah
data.gender_notes: Aisiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘As-Saa-‘iha’ which means ‘helpful’ or ‘supportive’. This name is mentioned in the Quran in the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) and his brothers. When Yusuf was sold into slavery in Egypt, he met two women who provided him with food and shelter. These women were called ‘As-Saa-‘ihaatain’, meaning ‘the two helpers’. Thus, Aisiah is a name of great significance, emphasizing the importance of kindness, generosity, and support towards others.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes kindness, generosity, and support towards others.
data.etymology: Aisiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help, Support.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aisiah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.context: Aisiah bint Abu Bakr (R) was the daughter of Abu Bakr (R), the first caliph of Islam. She is mentioned in association with the migration of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his companions from Mecca to Medina known as the Hijrah.

On platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn, users with the name Aisiah share content that embodies these values, showcasing their personal journeys of self-discovery and empowerment. Aisiah is not just a name, but a representation of a modern Muslim woman's identity, aspirations, and achievements.
